page.content:
Director of Monsters, Inc., Up, Inside Out, and Soul; later CCO.

How Pete Docter connects

  • Work: Inside Out — Pete Docter directed Inside Out.
  • Work: Soul — Pete Docter directed Soul.
  • Work: Monsters, Inc. — Pete Docter directed Monsters, Inc.
  • Faction: Pixar Braintrust — Docter is a long-running Braintrust director.

What is Pete Docter?

Pete Docter directed some of Pixar's most interior features — including Inside Out and Soul — and later became the studio's chief creative officer.

Key threads lead to Inside Out, Soul, Monsters, Inc. and Pixar Braintrust.
